audit_status.review_note: Illness, fear, grief, tears, death, prayer, and enemies.

verses.restored: O YHWH, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

familiar.text: O LORD, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

modern.text: O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.

verses.restored: Have mercy upon me, O YHWH; for I am weak: O YHWH, heal me; for my bones are vexed.

familiar.text: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; for I am weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed.

modern.text: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am frail; heal me, O LORD, for my bones are in agony.

original.text: חָנֵּ֥נִי יְהוָה֮ כִּ֤י אֻמְלַ֫ל אָ֥נִי רְפָאֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֖י נִבְהֲל֣וּ עֲצָמָֽי

verses.restored: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O YHWH, how long?

familiar.text: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O LORD, how long?

modern.text: My soul is deeply distressed. How long, O LORD, how long?

original.text: וְ֭נַפְשִׁי נִבְהֲלָ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד ואת יְ֝הוָ֗ה עַד מָתָֽי

familiar.text: Return, O LORD, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies’ sake.

modern.text: Turn, O LORD, and deliver my soul; save me because of Your loving devotion.

original.text: שׁוּבָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה חַלְּצָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י ה֝וֹשִׁיעֵ֗נִי לְמַ֣עַן חַסְדֶּֽךָ

verses.restored: For in death there is no remembrance of you; in Sheol who will give you thanks?

familiar.text: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?

modern.text: For there is no mention of You in death; who can praise You from Sheol?

original.text: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ין בַּמָּ֣וֶת זִכְרֶ֑ךָ בִּ֝שְׁא֗וֹל מִ֣י יֽוֹדֶה לָּֽךְ

verses.restored: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.

familiar.text: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.

modern.text: I am weary from groaning; all night I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears.

modern.text: My eyes fail from grief; they grow dim because of all my foes.

translation_notes: This chapter expands corpus coverage while remaining explicitly pending a deeper Hebrew/source-witness audit. KJV is retained only as the familiar comparison layer.

The completion draft intentionally preserves coherent traditional English syntax where a verse has not yet received a curated Hebrew-sensitive rendering; it does not mix archaic and modern grammar. Major identified lexical/textual issues receive explicit overrides and notes.
safety_note: Illness and emotional suffering are not evidence of divine punishment, weak faith, or moral failure.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Scrolls where extant, and other relevant witnesses during the global audit.
Preserve Psalm numbering and superscription differences across Hebrew and Greek traditions rather than silently harmonizing them.
